substitutes.name: Straight Leg Raises
substitutes.description: Lift the straight leg to about 45 degrees and lower with control.
substitutes.startPosition: Lie on your back with one knee bent, the other leg straight
substitutes.movement: Tighten the quad and raise the straight leg to about 45 degrees
substitutes.endPosition: Lower the leg slowly back to the floor
substitutes.whyItHelps: Loads the quadriceps without the deep knee flexion that provokes symptoms.
